company_pe.pat_basis: attributable to owners; total Rs 144.91 cr
company_pe.source: RHP pp. 183-185 (Basis for Offer Price); PAT p. 102
company_pe.note: The EPS is on 12.75 crore weighted shares before the CCD conversion and the pre-IPO placement; on the 15.01 crore pre-offer shares FY26 EPS is Rs 9.70 (P/E 28.0x at Rs 272). Price band from a single aggregator, unconfirmed at writing.

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -32.3% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 33.7 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

business_stage: Established, acquisition-led growth (brands bought from multinationals; seeds scaled via I&B Seeds)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 17-Nov-2026; allocation not yet published at writing

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the working upper band of Rs 272 (from a single aggregator, unconfirmed at writing; the call will be re-checked when the band is officially announced): Neutral value Rs 190 is 30.1% below and the Bull value Rs 225 is also below the price, so the call is Avoid - by a hair. At Rs 271 or below it reads Neutral; at Rs 259 (floor) Neutral value is 26.6% below. No material governance issue; the auditor's modified opinion concerns a Rs 16.30 cr insurance receivable on the balance sheet.
reference_note: Working band Rs 259-272 (single aggregator, unconfirmed; RHP prints [●]); pre-IPO placement at Rs 272.07 (p. 123). At Rs 272: 16.32 crore post-offer shares, market cap Rs 4,438 cr; P/E 30.5x FY26 PAT to owners (27.1x adjusted for the CCD fair-value loss and exceptional item); company's own P/E 23.8x basic / 24.6x diluted; P/B 2.06x post-offer; EV/EBITDA 9.6x FY26 adjusted EBITDA.
headline: A Delhi-based agrochemicals and seeds company (FY26 revenue Rs 3,152 cr, adjusted EBITDA margin 15%, PAT Rs 146 cr) that has grown by buying brands from multinationals, raising Rs 355 cr of fresh money to cut debt, priced at 30.5x FY26 earnings against a 20x peer median; fair value Rs 190 (Avoid, by a hair) because brand amortisation and working capital keep returns on equity near 8%.
red_flags: Brand amortisation Rs 142.73 cr in FY26, about equal to PAT, from Rs 726 cr of acquisitions in FY25; intangibles Rs 782.10 cr (pp. 99, 104, 508)
Auditor's modified opinion: Rs 16.30 cr insurance claim receivable should not be recognised (balance sheet only) (p. 448)
Working capital 38% of revenue; borrowings Rs 820.04 cr at Mar-26; Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 43.47 cr vs PAT Rs 135.78 cr (seasonal) (pp. 99-104)
Band Rs 259-272 from a single aggregator, unconfirmed at writing; fair value Rs 157 / 190 / 225 vs Rs 272

strengths: 193 product brands, incl. acquired Gramoxone, Bavistin, Tilt, Furadan (pp. 305, 308)
Backward integration into technicals at Dahej and Nagpur (p. 307)
Top-3 in pearl millet and mustard seeds (p. 306)
opportunities: Debt repayment from the issue lowers interest
